description: Needs a free TronRelic account: calling it makes your app ask the user to sign in, then the call runs. Read one or more published site pages in full, including the markdown body. Use after pages-list or pages-search to read the pages you picked, or directly when you already know a page's path or link. Parameters: pages (required, 1 to 5 entries). Each entry is a page id from a list or search result (a UUID), a slug starting with / such as "/about", or a full URL to a page on the site, which is reduced to its path. A slug the page used to have still finds it, at its current slug. Returns pages[], one per entry in the order given, of { requested, found, page }. page is { id, slug, title, description, keywords, ogImage, updatedAt, markdown, truncated, totalCharacters } or null when no published page answers to the entry; null is a normal result, not an error. markdown is the body without its frontmatter, cut to 20000 characters, with truncated true and totalCharacters set when it was cut. Pages are TronRelic's admin-written site pages served at paths such as /about. A site page is standing reference content kept current at a fixed address, such as a guide, explainer, policy, or documentation. Dated writing about something that happened, such as news, a market update, or a time-bound analysis, is a blog post, not a page; use the blog tools for those when they are available. These tools return only published pages exactly as visitors see them; drafts and edits waiting for review are never returned. Read-only; never changes a page.

pages.description: 1 to 5 pages to read, by id, slug, or URL.

items.description: A page id (UUID), a slug starting with /, or a full URL to the page.

name: pages-get
title: Read site pages
